shared_elements: T-shaped upright pillar treated as a carved surface
low-relief quadruped in profile on the lower shaft
geometric/net-like patterned zone on the upper broad face
horizontal band of repeated motifs across the top
animal figures oriented in profile facing sideways
justification: Both surfaces are T-shaped uprights bearing shallow relief in registers: a patterned/repeated-motif zone on the broad upper face over one or more profile quadrupeds on the shaft below, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest difference in content is that B carries a much richer inventory — a row of arched motifs, a fringe-like band of vertical strokes, birds and snake-like forms combined with the quadrupeds — while A shows only a sparse net/mesh pattern and a single faint animal.
